description: classify gives ∅ for a key that no entry names, and a %classifier with no entries names a classifier whose every key gives ∅ (engine §2, §10).
grammar:
%classifier lex
  "mi" ∈ KOhA
%classifier none
%rule text [word] ...
%rule word $w(W) <~w ∪ classify(phonemes($w), lex) ∪ classify(phonemes($w), none)>
%emits
  $
